strategies.name: Danny Longshots Redistricting Pair
strategies.description: Stu groups Indiana and Illinois together as twin long-shot redistricting flyers under the same thesis: if Republicans push redistricting aggressively enough in red/purple states, heavily blue states like Illinois may retaliate and redistrict back, and fence-sitting states like Indiana may be pressured to join in. Both are at 7% — 13-14x payout — and Stu explicitly names them as a duo, saying 'those are two if you want to get playful, I would go there.'
